lead_story.topic: Caleb Williams suffers non-contact hamstring injury, carted off in tears — Bears QB status uncertain for Week 3
lead_story.headline: Caleb goes down

tweets.text: Oh man ... Bears QB Caleb Williams is down, just yelled in pain.
Bears coach Ben Johnson says Caleb Williams: "He's in good spirits." Says they won't know the severity until Monday.

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Bears scored 59 points in Week 1 (tied for 2nd-most in Week 1 in NFL history), now lose their QB in Week 2 after scoring only 3. Emotional whiplash for Chicago. Cross-reference the Week 1 euphoria (Ben Johnson pursuing Broncos' single-season scoring record) against this disaster — panik-kalm-panik structure. Vikings defense held Bears to 3 points (12-3 final score per ground truth). BackAftaThis: 'Maybe Chicago's 59 points last week won't be their worst game of the year after all.' The non-contact nature is the scariest part — hamstring injuries for mobile QBs can linger. Johnson said won't know severity until Monday, but the cart and tears suggest it's serious. Bears fans watched him leave in tears, gave him a thumbs-up ovation. What does this do to the scoring-record chase? What does this do to the hype after Week 1? Find the stat: how rare is it for a QB to score 59 in Week 1 and then get carted off in Week 2? The contrast is the story.

supporting_stories.topic: Jayden Daniels dislocates left elbow vs Cowboys, X-rays show no fracture — will miss some time, Commanders rally around Marcus Mariota
supporting_stories.headline: Jayden's elbow

tweets.text: Disastrous end to the half for the Commanders, and now Jayden Daniels is down. His left elbow bent backwards.

Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

supporting_stories.research_notes: The elbow bent backwards on the final play of the first half — Daniels tried to brace his fall, and the joint gave. X-rays showed no fracture, but Quinn said 'we'll rally around Marcus (Mariota),' which tells you Daniels is out for a while. More tests Monday. Washington lost 37-20. The timing is brutal: disastrous end to the half, then the injury on top of it. The visual of the elbow bending is the hook. Find the stat: how rare is an elbow dislocation for a QB? Compare to Tua's situation (oblique, also Week 1/2). Both rookie-year QBs, both hurt early, both teams now turning to veteran backups. The rally-around-Mariota quote is the landing — it's over for Daniels in the short term.

supporting_stories.topic: Chiefs survive Colts in OT thriller 33-30 — Mahomes 3 TD, controversial replay, Colts play for tie late
supporting_stories.headline: Chiefs survive

tweets.text: Cannot believe the Colts played for the tie. Totally predictable play calling after getting it down the field. Coaching scared!

supporting_stories.research_notes: Mahomes: 32-47, 382 yards, 3 TD. Jonathan Taylor tied it twice — once in regulation, once in OT. The Laquon Treadwell play is the controversy: fumble or down by contact? Reviewed, ruled down. Mahomes postgame: 'I was actually kinda glad because I didn't want to see Twitter's reaction if they would've called it a fumble.' Then the Colts played for the tie late in OT instead of going for the win — KevinOConnor: 'Cannot believe the Colts played for the tie. Totally predictable play calling after getting it down the field. Coaching scared!' Butker hit the game-winner. BillBarnwell: 'Chiefs get all the calls.' The Colts had a chance to win it, and they kicked a FG to extend OT. That's the story: the controversy, the coaching scared, and Mahomes surviving again. Alec Pierce left in a walking boot.
